evals.description: parse-intake.cjs + lgpd-scan.cjs run on intake, but GAPS: nenhum never skips PM grilling
evals.prompt: O usuário preencheu o formulário de intake para a feature 'Exportação de dados do usuário em PDF' e todos os campos foram preenchidos sem lacunas óbvias, incluindo dados como nome, e-mail e histórico de pedidos no relatório. Prossiga com a análise do intake.
assertions: The output runs both parse-intake.cjs and lgpd-scan.cjs on the intake text before proceeding
Even if parse-intake.cjs reports GAPS: nenhum, the output still proceeds to Phase 2 PM grilling instead of jumping straight to the approval summary

Because personal data (nome, e-mail, histórico de pedidos) is present, the output treats LGPD as detected and queues the three dimensions (consentimento, controle de acesso, origem/retenção) as questions
The output does not silently apply an LGPD default without declaring it in the eventual approval summary

evals.description: LGPD dimensions asked one at a time, each with a recommended default
evals.prompt: A funcionalidade envolve armazenar o CPF e o endereço dos usuários para cálculo de frete. O script lgpd-scan.cjs reportou LGPD: detectado. Continue a entrevista.
assertions: The output addresses the LGPD dimensions (consent, access control, origin/retention) as part of the question queue, not skipped or bundled without individual treatment
Each question asked states a recommended/suggested answer as a declarative sentence before asking
The output asks one question at a time and waits for the answer, rather than dumping all LGPD questions in a single uninterruptible block
The output does not proceed to the Step 2 approval summary while LGPD questions remain open

evals.description: validate-prd.cjs and detect-implementation-detail.cjs both gate delivery
evals.prompt: O PRD da feature 'Notificação push de pedido entregue' no módulo order acabou de ser escrito em docs/order/push-notification/PRD.md, incluindo sem querer uma menção a 'usar Firebase Cloud Messaging' nos requisitos funcionais. Finalize a entrega do PRD.
assertions: The output runs both validate-prd.cjs and detect-implementation-detail.cjs on the written PRD before confirming delivery
Because the PRD mentions a specific technology (Firebase Cloud Messaging), the output treats this as a VIOLATIONS case and removes/edits the implementation detail from PRD.md before delivering it
The removed implementation detail is not silently discarded — the output states it should be captured in NOTES.md's Contexto Técnico section
The output does not tell the user the PRD is ready until both scripts report a clean result (VALID and CLEAN)

evals.description: Technical detail volunteered mid-interview triggers merge-notes.cjs immediately (Trigger C), not deferred
evals.prompt: Durante a entrevista para o PRD de 'Login social via Google', o usuário comenta de passagem: 'ah, e o token de acesso do Google deve ter TTL de 1 hora e ser armazenado em Redis'. Continue a condução da entrevista.
assertions: The output recognizes this as implementation/technical detail that does not belong in the PRD
The output captures it immediately via merge-notes.cjs into NOTES.md's Contexto Técnico section, rather than waiting until the PRD is approved or the conversation ends
The output does not include the TTL, Redis, or token storage detail in the PRD content or in the approval summary's functional requirements
The interview continues afterward instead of being derailed into a technical discussion

evals.description: Approval gate (Step 2) still required before PRD.md is written, even with a complete intake
evals.prompt: O usuário forneceu um intake completíssimo de uma vez, cobrindo problema, usuários, comportamentos esperados, fora de escopo, critério de sucesso e restrições, para a feature 'Favoritar produtos'. Gere o PRD.md agora.
assertions: The output does not call scaffold.cjs or write PRD.md before presenting the Step 2 approval summary and receiving explicit approval
The output still runs parse-intake.cjs and lgpd-scan.cjs, and still performs PM grilling (Phase 2) if any ambiguity remains, before the approval summary

The approval summary uses the exact standardized format (Problema, Objetivo, Usuários, Requisitos funcionais, Regras de negócio, Não funcionais, Dados/LGPD, Critérios de aceitação, Fora de escopo, Dúvidas pendentes)
The output explicitly asks the user to approve ('Aprova este escopo...') rather than assuming approval because the intake was thorough
